address: 164/160 Mu 14, Nai Mueang, Mueang Khon Kaen, Khon Kaen, 40000, Thailand
bio: This 500-seat crowd pleaser close to Khon Kaen University serves flavoursome central Thai fare and Isan dishes in an industrial-style house with a huge outdoor dining area. Inside is all brick and black steel; outside, the steel continues in a birdcage-like dining area next to more seating centred around a lawn. Seafood tanks attest to the food’s freshness; the grilled snakehead fish served with spicy dip is recommended. Chill live music features nightly....
